_readme: OGRA monthly LPG consumer price. Update on (or right after) the 1st of each month from the official notification. Same perKgPkr for all cities unless OGRA publishes a different city line (rare). verifiedBy must be a real checker name or 'THE LPG CO. team'.
_process: 1) Open https://www.ogra.org.pk/lpg-notified-prices or https://price.ogra.org.pk/ 2) Read per-kg consumer price and effective date 3) Add a new object at the TOP of notifications[] 4) Set verifiedOn to today 5) Commit and redeploy. Old months stay for history.

notifications.sourceNote: October 2026 OGRA consumer price as reported from the official notification cycle (Dawn / The Nation / ARY summarising OGRA: Rs 279.34/kg; 11.8 kg cylinder Rs 3,296.23). Re-check PDF on ogra.org.pk when the file is posted.
September 2026 prior month figure cited in October notification coverage (Rs 258.65/kg).
